claims.summary: Я representa а y puede marcar consonante suave; /a/ átona tras consonante palatalizada se fusiona con /i/ en la variedad descrita.

locator.text: Unstressed /a/ after palatalised consonants merges with /i/; realization varies with stress position.

locator.text: Я represents а and marks preceding consonant softness; at word beginning or after vowels it represents [j]+а.
